svg.aria-label: F126.4 flips, re-grade and better or worse: objects in memory
svg.title: F126.4 flips, re-grade and better or worse: objects in memory

g.text: F126.4 flips, re-grade and better or worse: objects in memory
as it is now, one criterion reworded
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: One re-grade of a live run, going. The desk holds the new run. The re-grader holds the run it re-grades and the eval file as it is now. For each repeat it keeps the marks it can and asks the judge for the rest, which records into the live run's play.
